scope: Owner prioritizes rational revisable musical interpretation over unresolved documentation. Broaden MIDI search, inspect event/control/part logs and stress-test note/form hypotheses against original YouTube audio; adopt usable per-track working decisions with revision triggers.
finding_effect: Private interpretive reference study; no runtime finding closed.
